groupProjectionBoundary: Exactly one named group or grupo parameter, a bounded literal ASCII group, no other arguments. No bank, entity, blank, alias priority or arbitrary field normalization. Opaque note bodies and all reference names remain byte-bound.
limitations: These local wrapper contracts do not expand arbitrary templates, establish whole-page visual equivalence, or turn an ambiguous model result into a proved rendering pass.
